text: The partner 'Ville de Troyes' is the French commune of Troyes itself: its own legal notice names the Ville de Troyes as publisher of ville-troyes.fr, with the mayor, Francois Baroin, as directeur de la publication.
short: Ville de Troyes is the municipality of Troyes.
